title: Great space heater and overall circulating fan!
text: Great space heater and overall circulating fan!. This is a really good room space heater and fan. I live in Florida and used it for a few weeks back at the end of April and now I am using for strictly room circulation/fan in my bedroom. With the constant storms we have down here in the late afternoons and evenings, the light whirring noise the fan makes helps to 'white noise' hide some of the thunderboomers too throughout the night (allowing me to sleep better). I really like this as my bedroom (which is 14x18 in size) gets full coverage from this unit. I highly recommend if you need a space heater or even just a fan for your room.

product_metadata.title: PureGuardian Guardian Technologies HTR410B Oscillating Whole Room Space Heater Tower & Fan with Remote Control, 27" Portable Heater, Black
features: Quick room warmth: 1500 watt heater with 2 settings delivers whole room warm air, fast
Auto heat control: programmable heater thermostat maintains your ideal room temperature
Fan only mode: switch to the 2 speed fan to cool the room
Quick even comfort: oscillating tower and powerful airflow design provide whole room coverage
Safe: tip-over switch, auto shut-off after 12 hours, overheat protection, debris screen helps protect the motor
description: The pure Guardian all season 2-in-1 tower heater and fan, with remote Control, offers warmth on chilly days. Use the fan only mode for a cool breeze on those warmer days. Designed for home or office use, the slim 27" Tower takes up very little space yet can quickly warm an entire room. The oscillating design propels warm or cool Air evenly throughout the room, offering 80 degrees of oscillating motion. The powerful 1500 Watt maximum heat output offers quick, comforting heat and allows you to program your ideal room temperature in the heat mode. The timer can be set to turn off after several hours of use and the unit is equipped with automatic shut-off feature that turns it off after 12 hours of continuous use for safety purposes. A remote is included for easy and quick control and a built-in carry handles allows for easy transport between rooms.
